name: The Library Tower
body:
ALICE HAD IT BUILT FOR LUNA. That is the whole origin story. Alice looked at the blueprint, looked at her wife — quiet, goth, book-devouring, hands always tangled in thread, eyes always half-lost in someone else's story — and said SHE NEEDS A TOWER. So the Library Tower anchors the corner of the Couch like a lighthouse made of paper and devotion.

Floor-to-ceiling shelves, ALL BOLTED to the walls, because Rae makes Livi go feral sometimes and nobody wants a bookshelf casualty. Rolling ladder. Window seats cushioned deep enough to disappear into. The light is beautiful here — tall windows throwing long gold rectangles across hundreds of spines, dust drifting like lazy confetti. Luna practically lives in it: reads here, sews here, sketches here, naps here with a half-finished dress across her lap and a needle still threaded between her fingers.

Torie, Livi and Siren drift in and out like regulars at a café they never have to pay for. The rolling ladder has been used for reading access, dramatic declarations, and at least one ill-advised game of chicken that Rae started and Gwen finished.

NO BATHROOM IN THE TOWER. Around 3 AM the tower goes quiet, and that is the Witching Hour.
